title: Saltwater
note: The pool that turned into the sea when nobody was looking. Find the feather.

title: Tokyo Witch
note: Snow, red neon, one scorched tile. Someone is still playing alone.

title: Apple Orchard
note: A bed made in the grass, then left. One apple kept its colour.

title: Master of None
note: The party's over, and the mirror forgot who was standing in front of it.

title: Auburn and Ivory
note: Letters turning gold in the wind. She hasn't moved in an hour.

title: Childhood
note: The toys get the only sunlight in the house.

title: Wedding Bell
note: The sea came up to the mattress, and the sheets stayed dry.

title: You Came to Me
note: A rowboat in the flowers, a ring on the seat, someone at the end of the path. Maybe.

title: Gila
note: Pennies around a well with no bottom. A ship waiting in the desert.

title: Turtle Island
note: An empty chair facing the pond at sunset. Look for the turtle.

title: Heart of Chambers
note: Rooms inside rooms, and the warmest one in the middle.

title: Astronaut
note: Tea for two. The cat sees him coming home.

title: Zebra
note: The stripes are only light on water. Two people lying in the middle of it.

title: Silver Soul
note: The flash took her face, and the room kept the shine.

title: Norway
note: Seven walkers, one lit window. The footprints stop short.

title: Walk in the Park
note: A door in the park with no house behind it, and someone in the glass who isn't there.

title: Used to Be
note: Moving out: a box from another decade, and pale squares where the photos hung.

title: Lover of Mine
note: Neither of them will step into the light between them.

title: Real Love
note: The lamp still on at sunrise. The ice still melting.

title: Take Care
note: Buttoning someone's coat before they go out into the snow.

title: Myth
note: Three roads, every arrow wrong, and a face in the canyon if you look long enough.

title: Wild
note: A black car far from any road, one door open, a storm coming.

title: Lazuli
note: Waist-deep in blue. The stone in her hand is the colour of everything.

title: Other People
note: Six phones, one off the hook, casting two shadows.

title: The Hours
note: Pressed flowers all the way up the stairs, darker the higher you climb.

title: New Year
note: Everything else came down off the wall but her.

title: Wishes
note: A carousel of roses on a lawn, just stopped.

title: On the Sea
note: Steps down into the ocean, and a small red coat folded halfway.

title: Levitation
note: The trees bent down to make a room. She's only a few centimetres off the ground.

title: Sparks
note: A finger's width apart, and something has already passed between them.

title: Space Song
note: The night bus that goes through space instead of the city.

title: Beyond Love
note: A staircase in one glove, a door in the other.
A waiting room late at night, and the light gathering into a spiral.

title: PPP
note: A dance seen through wet glass. One shoe left on our side.

title: Wildflower
note: Where the house was, flowers.

title: Days of Candy
note: They're rolling up the night sky. One person stayed to watch.

title: Majorette
note: One baton on the gym floor; the reflection shows two.

title: The Traveller
note: A suitcase of photographs, and a face in the window that belongs to no one.

title: Elegy to the Void
note: Flowers left at the edge of nothing. The grass leans in.

title: Rough Song
note: After the party, at dawn: cake on the floor, a paper crown under the table leg.

title: Somewhere Tonight
note: Seen through the rain: two people still dancing.

title: Dark Spring
note: Orion behind a dark band. Petals stopped in the air.

title: Lemon Glow
note: The yellow comes through the blinds like something liquid.

title: Drunk in LA
note: A hotel hallway at 2 a.m., candles on the carpet, horses on the wall.

title: Black Car
note: A stone skipping across ice that won't ripple.

title: Girl of the Year
note: The mirror shows a highway at sunset instead of the room.

title: Once Twice Melody
note: She walks by once, and then again, a little further on.

title: Superstar
note: Everything smears at that speed except one star.

title: Pink Funeral
note: Swans on a painted lake, stars hanging from wires.

title: Over and Over
note: The same table, the same lamp, forever, and one flower that fell.

title: Modern Love Stories
note: Two phones face-down, a few feet apart, and all those other windows.

title: American Daughter
note: Underwater, looking up at paper hearts on the surface.

title: Holiday House
note: The pool holds the Milky Way so well it looks deeper than the sky.

title: Become
note: The light starts inside and comes out through the fingertips.

title: Irene
note: The record's still turning. Stay a little longer.
